'''Jobany Cyrs''', a descendant of [[Kirr Cyrs]], was a native of [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]], and at twenty-three years of age was contracted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] member [[Idris Ro]] to scout the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] suitability as a base of operations. A freelance [[Scout/Legends|scout]] by trade, Jobany was sympathetic to the Alliance's cause during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and helped them scout many bases. However, his ancestry gave him a deep sense of nostalgia, and his scouting reports often read like travelogues. He traveled the galaxy in the modified [[Pathfinder-class scout ship|''Pathfinder''-class scout ship]] ''[[Outward Bound]]'' which has been in his family for several generations. Jobany had a strong emotional attachment to the Outward Bound for it has served his father, his grandfather, and several family members before him.
